Long. I had five calls with clients, and I read two articles for my master’s. I’m exhausted. How was yours?
Not bad. I finished a big project, and in the afternoon I ran errands: the bank and the vet.

Hi, honey, it's me. Sorry, I'm still at the office. My day was crazy. I had a meeting with a client in the morning, and now I have another meeting until seven. So I'm going to be home late, and I'm exhausted. How about ordering takeout tonight? Thai food, maybe? I can pick it up on the way. Oh, and one more thing: can you walk the dog before dinner? He didn't go out this afternoon. Let's watch a movie after dinner to wind down. OK, see you soon. Love you.

Hi, it's Giulia again. Yesterday was my day off, and it was perfect. In the morning I ran errands. I went to the post office and to the supermarket, and I finished my to-do list before eleven. Then my partner said: why don't we go to the lake for lunch? It is only one hour from Milan. So we took the car and had lunch by the water. We talked for hours. We work a lot, and we don't always have time to catch up. In the evening we were tired, so we didn't cook. We ordered pizza and watched an old movie. A simple day, but a very good one.
